method: Every one of the 35 original PNGs was directly opened through view_image at original detail with explicit per-image path/index mapping. No contact sheets, regenerated captures or image replacements were used. Per-image observations were recorded in twelve retained groups before this assembly.

captures.observation: Independent-parts view at 1.5 s shows the grey upright body, light-blue head and separate turquoise/light-blue extending arm pieces clearly framed against the reference grid. The object inspector, time controls and export-evidence panel are readable; no error or blank-render state is visible.

Gravity-and-release view at 1.5 s shows the turquoise carrier above the separate orange payload, with the curved recorded path visible. Both objects remain within the viewport; the payload inspector and release explanation agree with the displayed named case. No visible corruption or UI overlap.

The 720-pixel narrow view retains both visible carrier and orange payload and the 1.5 s timeline. Inspector and evidence panels reflow beneath the viewport, with controls and source/report expanders visible. Text wraps within panels without an obvious horizontal overflow or occlusion.

The repaired Agent artifact at 1.5 s visibly contains two separate grey rigs with light-blue heads and turquoise arms; their differing head sizes and positions are clear. The local-import UI correctly says numerical status is unknown, keeps source download disabled and shows no conformance claim. The loaded models and panels are fully framed.

The keyed-rack artifact at 1.5 s visibly has two distinct uprights: the left has fewer arms including a diagonal articulated member, and the right has five horizontal arms. Joint markers and recorded paths are visible. The local-import UI labels keyed-rack.glb, preserves unknown numerical status, and presents readable controls without error or clipping.

The two source objects project along this viewing direction, so the nearer form occludes the other; this image alone does not establish the hidden smaller object. limitations: This is a finite review of the exact 35 required screenshots and visible UI, not a continuous animation, all-camera, numerical geometry, physics or universal-rendering proof.
Several axial side views occlude one or more members. The corresponding front views expose them; no hidden surface is visually attested by an occluded view.
P04 and P11 use wide motion framing, making bodies small. Those screenshots support coarse silhouette, material separation, framing and visible-state review only.
The Agent and construction imported-GLB UI deliberately reports unknown numerical status; separate numerical/native records supply those checks.

The original 34-role invocation remains failed with 33 passing roles and one documents failure. This receipt does not convert that invocation to passed and does not itself establish documentation recovery, integration, release or handoff completeness.
